lead: An anchor window — `orient.py`'s inlined code, or a `peek.py` line range — carries no `impl` header, so the receiver type in it is a guess.
body: Methods of an inner type read as the outer type's, the tell is `error[E0599]: no method named ...` after a full rebuild, and `peek.py --locate` answers the symbol, not its owner. One `grep -n '^impl ' <file>` filtered to the lines around the anchor says which type you are adding a call to.
